app.name: Digital Experience Flow
app.description: Frontend journeys, funnels and root causes on RUM on Grail.

scopes.name: storage:user.events:read
scopes.comment: so a Configuracao (id da aplicacao mobile ainda fora da copia) e a coleta da analise por LLM, sob demanda e com orcamento

scopes.name: storage:spans:read
scopes.comment: Onde falha no backend e a analise pela IA (sob demanda, com amostragem); a ligacao pagina -> servico roda no workflow

scopes.name: storage:entities:read
scopes.comment: backend do fluxo: quem chama quem (modelo de entidades, o mesmo do Smartscape) e nome dos servicos

scopes.name: storage:buckets:read
scopes.comment: exigido pelo fetch em qualquer tabela do Grail

scopes.name: state:app-states:read
scopes.comment: jornadas de negocio salvas (compartilhadas entre usuarios)

scopes.name: state:app-states:write
scopes.comment: salvar/excluir jornadas

scopes.name: storage:metrics:read
scopes.comment: metricas nativas gratis: Apdex, Web Vitals, abertura do app, volume dos servicos

scopes.name: platform-management:effective-permissions:resolve
scopes.comment: mostrar a engrenagem de configuracao so para administradores

scopes.name: storage:bizevents:read
scopes.comment: copia enxuta de navegacao, erro e chamada de API (business events journeyflow.passo)

scopes.name: settings:objects:read
scopes.comment: tela de Configuracao: ler pipelines e roteamentos do OpenPipeline (Settings 2.0)

scopes.name: settings:objects:write
scopes.comment: tela de Configuracao: criar/atualizar pipelines e roteamentos

scopes.name: openpipeline:configurations:read
scopes.comment: tela de Configuracao: OpenPipeline

scopes.name: openpipeline:configurations:write
scopes.comment: tela de Configuracao: OpenPipeline

scopes.name: storage:bucket-definitions:read
scopes.comment: tela de Configuracao: ler buckets

scopes.name: storage:bucket-definitions:write
scopes.comment: tela de Configuracao: criar buckets dedicados

scopes.name: davis-copilot:conversations:execute
scopes.comment: Analise do problema pela IA generativa da Dynatrace (Davis CoPilot API), como o usuario que clicou

scopes.name: storage:events:read
scopes.comment: Analise pela IA: problemas do Davis (dt.davis.problems) e mudancas/deploys (events) como evidencia

scopes.name: storage:events:write
scopes.comment: acao de workflow def-agregar: grava os agregados por fatia de 5 min (business events no bucket rum_flow_agregados)

scopes.name: automation:workflows:read
scopes.comment: Configuracao: saber se o workflow do DEF existe (so leitura; criar e pelo app Workflows, que o app abre preenchido)

scopes.name: storage:system:read
scopes.comment: Configuracao: consumo do app pela cobranca da Dynatrace (dt.system.events, BILLING_USAGE_EVENT); so administrador
